title: The Path of the Chess Player
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji gazed upon all beings of the Three Realms with the Eye of Heavenly Way, in the most familiar corner, he saw that unforgettable face—Su Qingyao stood at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, her eyes hollow, as if she had never known him.

text.content: Dimensional rifts like ferocious giant mouths swallowed the entire Tianqing Sect in chaotic gray mist. Chen Ji stood alone on the ruins, beneath his feet were collapsed halls, in his ears the mournful wails. His robe was already tattered, his left arm hanging at his side, blood dripping from his fingertips onto the scorched earth. Yet the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand burst with dazzling golden light, forming a stark contrast with the gray dimensional erosion. "Have you thought this through?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the pages, his voice unusually grave. "Replacing the Heavenly Way... is not ascending to the peak, but stepping into eternal loneliness." Chen Ji gave no answer, only slowly lifting his head to gaze at the torn sky. In his eyes there was no fear, no hesitation, only a chilling calm.

dialogue.content: Foolish chess piece, you think by surpassing me you can escape the rules of this chessboard?

text.content: From the depths of the sky, an意志压落 that defies all description. That was the本体 of the Heavenly Way, an observer transcending all personality and emotion. It held no anger, no threat—merely stating a fact: whatever choice Chen Ji made, he would only be struggling within the rules it had predetermined. The dimensional erosion suddenly accelerated, as if urging Chen Ji to decide. In the distance came Ye Qing's anxious cries; she was barely holding back the rift's expansion with demonic fog. More cultivators were turning into withered bones in the gray mist, their souls dragged into eternal oblivion.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! What are you still standing there for!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice pierced through the chaos, reaching Chen Ji's ears. He turned his head, seeing that black figure swaying in the gray mist, the demonic fog being eroded inch by inch. Her face was pale as paper, yet she firmly stood before Chen Ji, refusing to retreat even half a step. Not just her. Chen Ji saw Su Qingyao's figure appearing on the other side—the Inner Sect Senior Fellow's sword intent sharp as frost, yet appearing so fragile before the dimensional erosion. She didn't look at Chen Ji, her gaze fixed on that torn sky, the sword in her hand trembling slightly. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "They will never understand. When you become the Heavenly Way, the you in their memories will completely vanish."

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record chose you because you have the coldest heart. But this is also the price—to become a chess player, you must sever all ties with the pieces.

text.content: Just then, a hazy figure emerged from the void. It was an elderly man, his features so blurred as to be almost invisible, yet emanating an suffocating ancient aura. The First Observer. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly tensed: "Why would you appear?" "Because the time has come." The old man's voice was calm as water. "Everyone who tries to replace the Heavenly Way faces this choice." He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying a barely perceptible trace of compassion. "Become the Heavenly Way, and you shall gain eternal will, power transcending dimensions, and limitless lifespan. But as the price..." The old man raised his hand, pointing toward Ye Qing and Su Qingyao, "They will forget your existence. In their world, there has never been a person called Chen Ji."

choice.prompt: The First Observer's words thundered like ten thousand galloping horses, shaking Chen Ji's spirit violently. Become the Heavenly Way, and the price is losing all bonds; abandon this path, and watch helplessly as all beings are destroyed. How should he choose?

choices.text: Replace the Heavenly Way, command eternity
choices.description: Become the new chess player, abandon all mortal bonds. From then on, observe the Three Realms in solitude, protect all beings, yet never be remembered by anyone again.
choices.visible_reward: Eternal will and power transcending dimensions

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, taking a deep breath. When he opened them again, his gaze was a dead, desolate calm. "I choose... to replace the Heavenly Way." The moment the words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment burst with unprecedented light, enveloping his entire being. Mo Xiansheng let out a long sigh, his remnant soul slowly dissipating, melting into the golden light as nourishment.

dialogue.content: From now on, there would be no Chen Ji in the Three Realms. Only... the Heavenly Way.

choices.text: Reject the Heavenly Way, protect the bonds
choices.description: Abandon the chance to surpass everything, choose to face destruction together with loved ones. Though destined to fail, at least they won't lose her.
choices.visible_cost: The Three Realms destroyed, all beings perish

text.content: Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly. He looked at Ye Qing, at Su Qingyao, at those fellow disciples perishing and the unseen common folk. After a long while, he spoke: "I refuse." The light of the Tianji Record suddenly dimmed, and the First Observer's figure let out a profound sigh: "Interesting... you are the first to refuse."

dialogue.content: I will not abandon them for power. Even if we must die, we die together.

text.content: The golden light grew brighter and brighter. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being torn apart, reorganized, and sublimated. He saw galaxies spanning countless light-years revolving, witnessed the alternation of millions of years, beheld the joys and sorrows of all living beings. All these images flew rapidly before his eyes, and he had to endure it all. At the same time, a sense of detachment rose from his heart. Ye Qing's figure gradually blurred in his vision; that face which had fought side by side with him was dissolving bit by bit. No! Chen Ji wanted to cry out, yet found himself unable to produce any sound. Instead, there came a perception beyond language—he "saw" Ye Qing's soul being modified, his memories in her mind scattering like paper torn apart by a wild wind, falling and dissipating piece by piece.

dialogue.content: Strange... why am I standing here?

text.content: Ye Qing's voice pierced through the dimensions, directly stabbing into Chen Ji's—no, now he should be called Heavenly Way's—perception. That tone was pure confusion, as if the she standing atop the ruins had no idea why she was there. Her demonic path mist had dissipated, because the bonds that drove her to fight no longer existed. Chen Ji wanted to respond, wanted to tell her everything, but the Heavenly Way's body no longer permitted any personal emotions. He could only watch helplessly as Ye Qing turned and flew away toward the demonic path, never looking back.

The same scene unfolded on the other side. Su Qingyao retracted her long sword, her brow furrowed, as if trying desperately to recall something, yet never grasping those elusive memory fragments. She glanced one last time at the figure emanating golden light atop the ruins, a flicker of inexplicable emotion passing through her eyes before ultimately turning into a cold snort. "Is there something... that I've forgotten in this world?" Her voice was soft, yet it thundered in Chen Ji's perception. Forgotten, yes. They would all forget him. From now on, there would be no Chen Ji in the world—only the eternal observer: Heavenly Way.

The dimensional rift began to heal. Heavenly Way's will replaced the chaotic erosion force, crushing all dimensional creatures attempting to flood in. The order of the Three Realms was being reconstructed, and all of this occurred under Chen Ji's will. He could feel the vibration of every speck of dust, the breath of every blade of grass, the life and death of every living being. What immense power this was, yet also what solitude. The First Observer's figure appeared once more, and this time, his features seemed clearer: "From now on, you will observe the Three Realms but cannot intervene in the slightest. You may foresee disasters but cannot act to stop them. You will watch the people you once protected experience joy and sorrow, separation and death, and all you can do... is record."

dialogue.content: This is the fate of a Chess Player. Once, you fought to protect; now, you can only watch them fight, get injured, and perish. Will you regret it?

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Way's Eye's question echoed in the void. Chen Ji had become the new Chess Player, yet had to endure eternal solitude. Would he regret it?

choices.description: To protect those he loved, he chose to bear eternal solitude. This was his resolve—never regret.

text.content: Chen Ji's answer came without hesitation: "No regrets." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "As long as they can live well, as long as the Three Realms can continue, what does one person's memory matter?" The Heavenly Way's Eye fell silent for a moment, then let out an indecipherable laugh: "You are more resolute than the First Observer..."

choices.text: A tremor still exists in the heart
choices.description: Even becoming Heavenly Way, there remains a tremor in the deepest part of his heart. That is the longing for bonds, the fear of solitude.
choices.visible_reward: A deeper understanding of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: May give rise to hidden dangers

text.content: "...I don't know." Chen Ji's voice trembled for the first time. "I chose this path, but I don't know... if I can bear it." The Heavenly Way's Eye showed no mockery, only saying calmly: "Hesitation is a stage every Chess Player must experience. Accept it, then transcend it." A mirror appeared in the void, and Chen Ji saw his own reflection within—not that废物 servant anymore, but an indescribable concentration of will.

On the ruins of Tianqing Sect, cultivators began clearing the debris. They did not know that just moments ago, this heaven and earth had nearly been devoured by dimensions. Nor did they know what price a man named Chen Ji had paid for all of this. Su Qingyao stood at the Sect Gate, gazing at the sky that was healing. Her brow furrowed slightly, as if trying desperately to recall something, yet to no avail. "Senior Sister Su, the Sect Master requests your presence in the Council Hall." A disciple came to deliver the message. Su Qingyao nodded and turned to leave. The moment she turned, a barely perceptible golden light fell from the depths of the heavens, gently touching her brow. She stopped, turned back to look at that已经完全愈合 sky, a dazed flicker in her eyes. "...It seems like I've forgotten something very important." She murmured softly, but no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember.

Meanwhile, in the direction of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing likewise stopped in her tracks. She stood upon a black cloud, gazing at the eastern horizon—that was the center of the Three Realms, the dwelling place of Heavenly Way. "Strange..." she murmured to herself. "Why do I always feel... like something is protecting me?" The demonic path mist swirled around her, but unlike before, it no longer carried aggressiveness—instead, there was a subtle gentleness that was hard to detect. Ye Qing shook her head, suppressed this inexplicable emotion, and resumed the coldness that a Holy圣女 of the Demonic Path should possess. In the distant sky, an invisible will was quietly observing all of this. It was the new Heavenly Way, the former Chen Ji. He watched his former beloved, former allies, former enemies continue their lives. And he could only observe, not intervene; only record, not change.

dialogue.content: You have done well. From now on, the Three Realms will continue under your observation. This is the mission of a Chess Player.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the void, carrying a calm that had long been anticipated. Chen Ji—or rather, the new Heavenly Way—gave no response. He merely quietly observed every corner of the Three Realms, sensing the joy and sorrow, birth and death of all living beings. He was a guardian, yet also the greatest loner. From then on, he would have no friends, no enemies, no lovers. All earthly bonds had been severed, leaving only the duties of an observer to accompany him until eternity. The dimensional rift fully healed, and the sky regained its long-missed azure. On the ruins of Tianqing Sect, cultivators began rebuilding their homes. Ye Qing returned to the Demonic Path, continuing her days as Holy圣女. Su Qingyao became the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, leading the sect toward new glory. They all forgot Chen Ji, but the sky that had been torn and healed seemed to retain an inexplicable悲壮 trace.

The new Heavenly Way hovered alone above the heavens, gazing down at the peace he had exchanged for eternal solitude. Tears could not fall from a Heavenly Way's body, but in the depths of his perception, there was a final resonance with the mortal world. He remembered many things: the astonishment when he first obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, the three thrilling battles with Su Qingyao, fighting side by side with Ye Qing in the Demonic Path's Forbidden Grounds, and that sister, Chen Nian, who had always tugged at his heartstrings... All memories were as clear as yesterday, yet could never be shared with anyone. "Was it worth it?" he asked himself. No one answered. But seeing the vibrant earth, the cultivators rebuilding their homes, his answer no longer mattered. What mattered was that they were still alive. The Three Realms continued. And he would continue to observe, continue to protect, until the end of time.

Just then, a faint light flickered in the depths of his perception. That was the core of the Tianji Record—the final spiritual light left by Mo Xiansheng before he dissipated. Chen Ji probed his consciousness into it and saw the words Mo Xiansheng had left: "When you feel lonely, remember—their existence itself is proof that you once lived." Chen Ji stared at these words for a long time, then let out a soft sigh. Not sadness, but acceptance. Yes, they forgot him. But as long as they were alive, as long as the Three Realms continued, he still existed within this heaven and earth. Not as flesh and blood, not as memory, but as the will to protect, as eternal observation. ...This was good enough too.

The new Heavenly Way withdrew his consciousness and turned his gaze back to the Three Realms. On the ruins of Tianqing Sect, new halls were rising from the ground; within the territory of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing was discussing something with the sect elders; cultivators of the three major sects were each busy with their own affairs, as if nothing had changed. But Chen Ji knew everything was different now. He had become the new Chess Player, protecting this heaven and earth, yet forever losing the qualification to place stones on the board. From now on, he could only watch, watch those he had once loved continue their lives. And he, in the identity of Heavenly Way, would witness every choice they made, every growth, every joy and sorrow. ...Until forever.
